title: 3 Anime Transformations People Mix Up
script: This is Super Saiyan. This is Kaioken. So what's the difference? Super Saiyan is a genetic Saiyan transformation triggered by rage, while Kaioken is a trained technique that multiplies ki at severe body strain. This is Bankai. This is Shikai. So what's the difference? Bankai is the ultimate final form of a Soul Reaper Zanpakuto, while Shikai is the initial unlocked blade form. This is Sage Mode. This is Nine-Tails Chakra. So what's the difference? Sage Mode draws natural energy from the environment, while Nine-Tails Chakra taps into Kurama demonic spirit energy. Follow for more.
